Subject: 14 hours back this week

Hey,

I deployed my third AI agent on Tuesday.

Marketing. Sales. Operations. All running before Wednesday morning.

This week I did not write a single LinkedIn post. I did not send a cold email. I did not pull a Stripe report.

The agents did all of it.

I worked 26 hours instead of 40. Same revenue. Same output.

Here is what I learned:

The skill is not technical. The skill is clarity. If you can write a brief for a freelancer, you can build an AI employee. The agent does what the brief says. Better brief, better output.

Most operators are still hiring humans for tasks an AI can run for $4 a day. Two years from now that will look insane.

If you have not deployed your first AI yet, this is the week.

Reply with your one biggest bottleneck. I will tell you which agent to build first.

Talk soon,
Daniel
